 overview   [list]   board    !lint

No filters · f picker · 1 todo  2 doing  3 done  4 depends
NAVIGATION AND FIND                                     EDIT · every action requires confirmation
j/k ↑/↓         move / scroll                                           [ and ]         previous / next check or dependency
< / gg / Home   top                                                     n and p         next / previous task, in a task
> / G / End     bottom                                                  u               in a task: up to the list (as Esc)
ctrl-d / ctrl-u half page down / up                                     Space/-/Enter/a tick / strike out check / follow dep > / answer ?
PgDn / PgUp     full page down / up                                     Tab / Shift-Tab in a task: focus page, checks, deps, links, files
h/← Shift-Tab   previous pane / column                                  E               in a task with files (⎘2): its folder in the editor
l/→ Tab         next pane / column                                      t / d / x       take / done / drop task
Enter           open full task detail                                   J / K           move below / above the next row, no confirm
Esc             back one level, never quits                             m / y, P p      grab: j/k, Enter places it / yank, paste above below
q / ctrl-c      quit (q only outside inputs)                            N               new title, goal and one verification item
/               live find; Enter goes to it, Tab keeps                  e               edit in $VISUAL, else $EDITOR, git core.editor, vi
:               palette with command + value completion                 e again         after an edit left a finding: edit at once
Tab / Enter     complete palette choice; Enter runs complete command    Enter / Esc     confirm / cancel every editing action
ctrl-n/p / ↑↓   select palette completion
?               help overlay, including from inputs
#               jump by id prefix / TASK-number alias
f               filter picker: s/t/p/g/l/a/e
1 / 2 / 3 / 4   filter todo / doing / done / blocked
Backspace / F   remove last chip / clear all filters
o / i / b / !   views: overview / list (also v) / board / lint
s / y           status / type palette (y: inside a task)
c               clear all filters
r               refresh now (changes on disk show by themselves)
: sort          order by fields; : sort rank to go back

PALETTE: overview, list, board, todo, doing, done, blocked, dropped, status <s>, type <t>, priority <p>, group <g>, label <l>, assignee <a>,
epic <id>, goto <id>, sort, lint, clear, help
Filter fields: s status, t type, p priority, g group, l label, a assignee, e epic. Blocked is a todo task with unmet dependencies; a doing
task stays doing, drawn blocked. Each task counts once. Filters combine.
